chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ibn Bukayr from some of our companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When a man dies and leaves behind his father who is a slave, and his mother who is a slave, and the deceased was free, then his father or his relatives are purchased from what he left, and the remainder of the wealth is inherited.
ai.seo_question: How is the estate of a free man distributed if his father and mother are slaves?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith details the specific mechanism of 'redemption' (fiʾ) within Shia inheritance law, where the cost to free a deceased free man’s enslaved parents is prioritized from the estate. This ruling highlights the juristic principle that manumission of direct ancestors takes precedence over general distribution, ensuring the deceased’s lineage is liberated before heirs receive their shares. It underscores the high value placed on freeing slaves in Shia fiqh as a form of posthumous piety and financial obligation.
